name: Arthurs Seat State Park Walks
address: Arthurs Seat State Park, Arthurs Seat VIC 3936
signature: A network of hinterland walks from the Peninsula's highest point — panoramic bay and ocean views, giant ferns, and trails for every fitness level
editorNote:
Arthurs Seat State Park contains a network of walking trails across the 305-metre summit and surrounding bushland — from short scenic strolls to half-day hikes through tree ferns and coastal scrub. The summit trail, Devil's Elbow track, and the ridge walk to Eagle Ridge lookout are the highlights.

The Seawinds Garden walk is the most accessible — a gentle loop through the formal gardens at the summit with bay views at every turn, suitable for all ages. The Woodland Walk descends through giant tree ferns and is one of the most lush 45-minute walks on the Peninsula regardless of season.

All walks start from either the summit (accessible via the Eagle gondola or the summit road) or from the Seawinds Gardens car park. Dogs permitted on some trails on leash — check Parks Victoria for current conditions.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's best hinterland walk network — ferns, ridgeline views, and trails that connect naturally with the Eagle gondola.
ifOnlyOneThing: The Woodland Walk descent through the tree ferns — 45 minutes, completely absorbing regardless of the season.
